sections.desc: 播客快照与 11-14 相同：Unsupervised Learning Ep 97 × TypeSafe CEO Jogo。完整中文译文（70 段）已收录于 11-14 期；今日保留金句回顾。

cards.authorTag: Jogo（TypeSafe 联合创始人 & CEO，Jev 之父）

rewrite: Replay note: today's podcast feed is unchanged from 2026-11-14 — Unsupervised Learning Ep 97 with the CEO of TypeSafe on decision models, benchmark fatigue, the KV cache tyranny and the Anthropic IPO. The full Chinese translation (70 paragraphs) was published on 11-14; today we keep a quote replay.
original: Jogo: What percentage of those calls going into the LLMs are actually meant for human consumption...? Even the most string-pilled of people will give many nines of percent for the machine native component.
Jogo: Why can we solve Millennium Prize problems in math but not automate anything touching accounting?
Jogo: I wrote a document at OpenAI that was titled, We Could Have Had AGI a Year Ago, at least by OpenAI's definition of AGI.
Jogo: the let them cure cancer is going to be like Marie Antoinette's, like, let them eat cake.
Jogo: I get the sense that the greatest strength of the labs is not models or product or distribution, but financial engineering.
Jogo: we need to start untraining ourselves of this lack of agency that LLMs have kind of taught us about AI and start really building again.

rewrite: 重播说明：今日播客快照与 11-14 相同——Unsupervised Learning Ep 97 × TypeSafe CEO Jogo（Jev 之父）：决策模型、benchmark 疲劳、KV cache 暴政与 Anthropic IPO 冷评（74442 字符）。完整中文译文（70 段）已收录于 11-14 期播客卡，今日不重复刊出。
original: 「进入 LLM 的调用里，多大比例是给机器消费的？最 string 上头的人也会答好多个 9。」
「为什么能解千禧年难题、却不能自动化任何碰会计的活？」
「我在 OpenAI 写过一份文档，标题就叫《我们一年前就能有 AGI》。」
「『让他们去治愈癌症』——会是这个时代的『让他们吃蛋糕』。」
「实验室们最大的强项不是模型、产品或分发——是金融工程。」
「戒掉 LLM 教给我们的无能动性，重新开始真正地构建。」
